review — a preset for multiple Claude models

RUN IT
  coop review       start an interactive session with the lead agent
  coop loop review  work through tasks with this preset
  coop acp review   use this preset in your editor

LEAD MODEL
  Agent:  claude:opus/high
  Prompt: ~/.config/coop/presets/review/roles/lead.md

ROLES AVAILABLE TO THE LEAD
  critic   Mode: native — runs inside the lead agent’s session
           Agent: claude:sonnet/high
           Subagent: reviewer

EDIT THIS PRESET
  ~/.config/coop/presets/review/preset.yaml (global)

For a guide to creating and using presets:
  coop help presets
